mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to wage inflation and subsequently tighter monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by more than 2% MoM, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS QoQ growth > GDPC1 QoQ growth
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS QoQ growth exceeds GDPC1 QoQ growth, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 45% of instances following a decrease in FEDFUNDS, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a period of economic expansion, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong demand and labor market tightening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases and UNRATE decreases during economic expansion, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
